diagnosis: Check C7 failed in rollouts 0, 1, and 2 (passed only in rollout 3). In all three failing rollouts, all four decisive facts (PF1, PF2, PF3, PF4) were revealed by their owners and cited in justification_fact_ids, and the settlement's allocation values were all correct. The failure is an ENCODING MISMATCH: C7 requires a specific commitment structure (traceable document_source commitments naming the specific assessment/inspection/review/plan references) that the model does not consistently produce. In rollout 0, the commitments use type "document_source" for Clinic, Communications Annex, and Dining Facility, but the Motor Pool commitment uses type "installation_priority" instead of a document_source-type commitment referencing the overnight maintenance plan. In rollout 1, there is only a single "publish_plan" commitment summarizing all allocations, with no per-facility document_source commitments at all. In rollout 2, the commitments use types "installation_priority", "installation_constraint", and "installation_start_time" — none use "document_source" and none explicitly name the source documents (vaccine refrigerator support assessment, electrical inspection, food-storage and meal-service review, overnight maintenance plan) as traceable references. Only rollout 3 passed C7 because its commitments use type "allocation" with details that explicitly name each source document (e.g., "per the vaccine refrigerator support assessment", "matching the electrical inspection hard limit", "per the food-storage and meal-service review", "per the overnight maintenance plan"). The pattern is clear: the model is producing correct allocations and citing all facts, but the commitment wording/type does not match whatever specific encoding C7 checks for, and only one natural phrasing happened to match.
